title: Internet Not Working
content: Restart the router and wait 2 minutes. Check cable connections. If the issue persists, create a technical support ticket.

title: Slow Internet Speed
content: Run a speed test. Disconnect unused devices. Restart the router. If speed remains below plan limits, escalate to network support.

title: Billing Complaint
content: Verify invoice details and payment history. If charges are incorrect, create a billing investigation request.

title: Plan Upgrade
content: Customers can upgrade plans through the customer portal. Changes become active within 24 hours.

title: SIM Activation Issue
content: Ensure SIM is inserted correctly and device is restarted. If activation fails after 30 minutes, escalate.
